label: Whatever is in potency in no respect is eternal in Boethius' typed sense: it lives at some time of…
paraphrase: Whatever is in potency in no respect is eternal in Boethius' typed sense: it lives at some time of the duration frame, its life has neither beginning nor end, and it has no succession. This is a typed specialization, distinct from STMT-IMMUTABLE-IS-ETERNAL with its primitive Eternal; relating them needs a recognition commitment that is not asserted.
